name: Zhangye Big Data Industrial Park and Huawei Big Data Center Industrial Chain Development Project
developer: Zhangye City Investment Development Group Co., Ltd.; Huawei Software Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Project page says the park is in Ganzhou district, includes an 11,662 sq m data center plus cloud computing resource pool, and was under construction with operation targeted by end-2021; no MW disclosed.

name: Chaozhou Cloud Computing Data Center
developer: China Telecom Chaozhou Branch; Shenzhen Pangu Data Co., Ltd.
notes: Chaozhou Daily report says the center was unveiled at China Telecom Chaozhou, started in 2016, total investment RMB 547 million, total building area about 7,400 sq m, with Tencent and ChinaCache/Blue I.T. named as tenants; no MW disclosed.

name: Huawei Dongguan Cloud Data Center T1
developer: Huawei
notes: Huawei says the T1 project is on the east side of Songshan Lake in Dongguan, serves as Huawei Cloud's Southern China base, entered operation in 2019, and reached PUE 1.28 in 2021; no MW disclosed.

name: Dongguan Taikeyuan Cloud Data Center
developer: Taikeyuan; CIMC Digital Power listed as modular data center provider
notes: CIMC project page lists a Dongguan cloud data center of 17,604.57 sq m, 5 floors and 517 modules, finished in 2019; no MW disclosed.

name: Fujitsu South China Data Center
developer: Fujitsu (Guangdong) Technology Services Co., Ltd.; Foshan Nanhai District partner
notes: Fujitsu announced groundbreaking for its first world-class China data center in Guangdong Financial High-Tech Service Zone, Nanhai, Foshan; phase one investment about US$30 million, 10,000 sq m, about 1,000 server cabinets, expected completion in 2011; no MW disclosed.

name: Greater Bay Area Runze (Foshan) International Information Port
developer: Runze Technology Development Co., Ltd.
notes: Signed in Gaoming in July 2020; planned investment RMB 5 billion, 223 mu, five high-grade data centers, 200,000 sq m data center environment, first phase two buildings with about 12,000 racks. Runze later reported phase-one structural topping-out in November 2021; no MW disclosed.

name: GDS Guangzhou GZ3 Data Center
developer: GDS Holdings Ltd.
notes: GDS announced acquisition of purpose-built Guangzhou GZ3 with around 13,000 sq m potential IT area; phase 1 of about 6,600 sq m had entered service and was fully committed by a major cloud/internet customer; no MW disclosed.

name: Guangzhou Yungu Phase II Data Center
developer: Guangzhou Dehuang Investment Co., Ltd.
notes: Guangzhou planning notice lists Yungu Phase II Data Center substation/oil-pit works in Nansha, with project registration 2019190000019806. Guangzhou 2021 key-project plan describes phase II as three data-room buildings, about 73,000 sq m total construction area and 9,000 standard cabinets; no MW disclosed.

name: Guangzhou Lianggong Lixing Data Center Project
developer: Lianggong/Lixing project sponsor not identified in public key-project list
notes: Guangzhou key-project lists identify the Zengcheng project as a cloud-computing center using existing A1/A2 four-floor plants, 34,107.29 sq m floor area, PUE below 1.31, international T3+ grade, and 7,100 standard cabinets; listed as completed in the 2024 key construction plan. No MW disclosed.

name: Guangzhou Artificial Intelligence Public Computing Center
developer: Guangzhou Data Group / Digital Guangzhou Innovation Laboratory
notes: Guangzhou government digital-economy plan says the city has built the Guangzhou AI Public Computing Center and 924P citywide intelligent-computing scale; 2025 city report says the center deployed DeepSeek-R1/V3 services and can support 1,000 enterprise connections. No MW disclosed.

name: Alibaba Guangdong Cloud Computing Data Center Yuancheng Project
developer: Alibaba Information Port (Guangdong) Co., Ltd.
notes: Yuancheng district planning notice describes a 2026 building-plan adjustment for the Alibaba Guangdong cloud computing data center at Gaopugang 8th Road; related Heyuan/Yuancheng environmental and construction notices cover a 110 kV substation and later expansion/acceptance items including data center buildings. No MW disclosed.

name: Keppel Huizhou Data Centre
developer: Keppel Data Centres; Huateng Smart Technology as operator
notes: Keppel announced a RMB 1.5 billion greenfield data center in Tonghu Smart City, Huizhou, with two data-center buildings, about 45,000 sq m initial floor area, more than 6,000 high-density cabinets, and staged delivery from 2021; no MW disclosed.

name: China Mobile Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Huizhou) Data Center
developer: China Mobile Guangdong / Huizhou Huidong County Government
notes: Bay Area portal/Southcn report says Guangdong Mobile and Huidong County signed to build the project in Baihua town's Moling Industrial Zone; planned investment RMB 5 billion, 200 mu site, 190,000 sq m floor area, 32,000 rack installation capacity; no MW disclosed.

name: Greater Bay Area Runze (Huizhou) International Information Port
developer: Runze Technology Development Co., Ltd.; Tianren Investment Co., Ltd.; China Telecom Guangdong as operating partner
notes: Runze says the Huizhou information port started construction in Baihua town, covers 192 mu, plans 200,000 sq m of high-standard data-center rooms, and was planned for completion/operation by end-2023; no MW disclosed.

name: Yunhong Data Center Project
developer: Aerospace Yunhong Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Southcn/Nanfang+ report says Huidong signed the Yunhong data center project on 2020-05-25, total investment RMB 4.5 billion, planned completion and operation by end-2022, expected annual output RMB 2 billion; no MW disclosed.

name: Pearl River Investment Big Data Center Project
developer: Pearl River Investment
notes: Bay Area portal/Southcn report says the RMB 5 billion Pearl River Investment big data center signed into the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Huizhou) Data Industrial Park as its fourth large data-center project; no MW disclosed.

name: Keppel Guangdong Data Centres 1, 2 and 3
developer: Keppel DC REIT / Keppel Data Centres
notes: Keppel DC REIT identifies Guangdong Data Centres 1, 2 and 3 as seven-storey facilities in the Bluesea Intelligence Valley Mega Data Centre Campus in Jiangmen; DC1 and DC2 completed in 2019/2020 and DC3 shell completed in 2020 with fitting-out expected by Q3 2023. No MW disclosed.

name: Jiangmen AI Computing Center at Heshan Bluesea Data Center
developer: Guangdong Bluesea; China Mobile Jiangmen as operator
notes: Jiangmen government says the municipal AI computing center landed at Heshan Bluesea Data Center on 2024-12-19, is built by Guangdong Bluesea and operated by Jiangmen Mobile, has completed supporting delivery with 8,145 cabinets, reached nearly 500 PFLOPS by June 2026, and targets 2,000 PFLOPS by end-2026. No MW disclosed.

name: Guangdong Provincial Government Big Data Center Jieyang Node Phase I
developer: Jieyang Municipal Government / Guangdong digital government program
notes: Jieyang government notice says the Guangdong provincial government big data center city-integrated Jieyang node phase I started construction and would support municipal data sharing, data management and applications. No MW disclosed.

name: Jieyang Unicom Cloud Data Center
developer: China Unicom Jieyang
notes: Jieyang government reply states the city had built eastern Guangdong's largest cloud data center, invested by Jieyang Unicom, listed as a city key project, covering over 20 mu with total building scale about 19,000 sq m. No MW disclosed.

name: Maoming Storage Power Center (Trusted Data Space) Equipment and Software Procurement Project
developer: Maoming Maofa Data Storage Technology Co., Ltd.; China Mobile Guangdong Maoming Branch reported as winning supplier in later summary
notes: Procurement notice describes Maoming Storage Power Center / trusted data space infrastructure with 53.75 PB raw storage, 72 storage devices, 20 hyperconverged devices, 40 data-center platform software sets, 54 network devices and 16 security devices; budget about RMB 101.1 million. Sources are procurement aggregators, so confidence is lower; no MW disclosed.
